posts.title: Midnight Sunwatch
posts.text:
🌙 Midnight Sunwatch — September 12, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B3.1)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B8.5 (Peaked September 11, 2026 at 23:14 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 409 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.33)

Looks pretty quiet right now. 🌎✨

Today’s images show several small sunspots, broad coronal holes, and bright active-region loops, while the coronagraph appears routine.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 171 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
